name: Kwan Wei Loong
tagline: Cybersecurity student focused on offensive security and network defense — building, breaking, and writing up what I find.
about: I'm a third-year cybersecurity student at Cascade University, spending most of my time in home-lab ranges, CTFs, and bug bounty write-ups. I'm particularly interested in web application security and Active Directory attack paths, and I'm currently studying for OSCP.
skillsRaw:
Offensive: Web app pentesting, Active Directory attacks, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap
Defensive: SIEM (Splunk), Log analysis, Incident response basics, Network monitoring
Tools & languages: Python, Bash, Linux, Wireshark, Git

projects.title: Home Lab AD Range

projects.title: TryHackMe / HTB Write-ups
projects.description: Ongoing collection of room and box write-ups covering web exploitation and privilege escalation methodology.
